text:
maria (Product): Quick sync — launching Tempo prewarm for enterprise customers next sprint. Need a cross-team gating checklist before canary: 1) runtime perf (p95 SLA target 50ms on short requests), 2) infra capacity for reserved pools + burst slots, 3) security sign-off for KMS/HSM flows, 4) rollout runbook + automatic fallback. Can each team confirm owners and blockers? cc @devin @kai @nora @sam :spiral_note_pad:

devin (Eng): I can own feature flags + canary config. Q: can we relax 50ms to 60ms for the first week to reduce scope?

kai (Runtime): 50->60ms depends on batching and chat vs short-ctx mix. Tight if KV-cache miss rate is high. We need a perf ward for cache hit expectations. Also need a decision on using quantized-8 model variant to cut cost.

nora (Infra): We have base slot capacity for reserved pools, but autoscaling policy needs tuning for burst. Won't guarantee >2x burst without load tests. Also will need VPC subnet ranges for private pilot — that blocks staging infra.

sam (Security): KMS integration in progress. HSM cert rotations and EKM approvals may add work. If the customer requires EKM/HSM we need legal + compliance sign-off (estimate ~2 weeks).

alex (Eng SRE): Add observability gates: per-route p95, token-cost delta, error-budget burn. I'll draft alert thresholds and runbook snippets for rollback.

maria (Product): Good. Devin — own per-route rollout runbook? Kai — produce a short perf profile (p50/p95 under common batch sizes) by Tue EOD. Nora — what do you need from Product to allocate subnets? Sam — confirm HSM/EKM approval timeline.

devin (Eng): I'll own the runbook and rollback criteria. Plan: initial canary limited to 5 tenants, gradual ramp to 25 over 48h if gates hold.

kai (Runtime): I'll run benches with quantized-8 and fp16 variants. Need a sample traffic trace (10k requests across user flows) from Product to reproduce real mixes. Also will measure KV cache hit sensitivity.

maria (Product): Uploaded sample trace to #files (link). Note: Customer X requests private VPC + HSM; they're in the pilot cohort.

nora (Infra): Send expected peak slots per tenant and desired VPC CIDR. I'll prepare terraform snippets and a staging plan for routing and NAT. Without CIDR and slots we can't size the reserved pool.

sam (Security): For HSM/EKM we need SOC2 change window and legal review. Start the approvals now; if legal requests contract changes that could push timeline.

alex (Eng SRE): Canary SLI proposal: error rate <0.5% overall, p95 latency <60ms. If either breaches for 10m, trigger automated rollback and paging. Also add token-cost regression >10% as a soft gate.

devin (Eng): One more ask: is model quantization approved given any regulatory constraints for private customers?

sam (Security): Quantization itself is fine, but we disallow third-party obfuscation libs and require internal code reviews and dependency scan. Will sign off after code + infra review.

maria (Product): To summarize owners: Devin (runbook & rollout), Kai (perf), Nora (infra), Sam (security), Alex (SRE). Blockers: HSM approvals, autoscale policy tuning, perf validation against sample trace. Target: start canary Wed 09:00 next week. Any objections?

kai (Runtime): No objections. Delivering perf profile Tue EOD.

nora (Infra): No objections pending VPC CIDR + tenant slots.

devin (Eng): No objections. Runbook draft posted in #files later today.

sam (Security): Aware — starting approvals. Will flag if legal needs contract addendum.

maria (Product): Great — I'll create a launch board ticket and add the gating checklist. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled — canary start Wed 09:00 UTC.

maria (Product): Thanks everyone. I'll follow up in the launch ticket with dates and owners. If any blocker appears, ping the thread and I'll escalate. :rocket:
